pristine.sourcePolicy: upstream test:types compiles the complete React adapter source program

adapted.sourcePolicy: adapted test:types compiles the complete Octane adapter source program paired by fileMap

permittedTransformations.rule: devtools.tsx becomes devtools.tsrx for the Octane component module
react / react-dom imports become octane; local ./devtools becomes ./devtools.tsrx
JSX.Element / ReactElement become Octane renderable shapes
Every upstream export must remain after rename transforms; adapted-only extras require allowedExtraExports
Program-membership and export-surface controls reject skipped mapped files, unmapped extras, missing required exports, and undeclared additive exports

divergences.rule: Public adapter types keep framework-prefixed names on each side
Adapted index.ts may re-export framework-neutral core symbols listed in allowedExtraExports

notes: Required type lanes compile the paired source programs declared by fileMap. Public-API probes under probePair remain supplementary assertion inventories and do not substitute for source-program membership.
